data.reason: verify-before-done: round 1 has build, test, lint red — completion blocked

data.text: Plan session: verify-before-done round 1 is red for an environment reason, not a code reason. The plan worktree (sdlc__CHG-0002__plan) was created without node_modules, so all three commands fail with "command not found" (tsc, vitest) and the global eslint 8.24.0 crashes on .git/**. This is the uninstalled-worktree gap the spec's C7 and plan step 0 describe. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` needs an approval this headless session cannot grant. No code was changed in this session; plan.md rev 2 (final, commit 260c6a61) is the deliverable and gate 3 is open. Note also: even after an install, `pnpm test` in this worktree under SDLC_CHANGE=CHG-0002 would show the six hook-test failures CHG-0002 exists to fix, since the test file is unchanged at the plan stage.

data.title: R6 evidence missing from the PR: the committed round is agent-reported, the Stop hook's own round is uncommitted
data.detail: Spec R6 and plan Proof R6 require "the CHG-0002 ledger carries a `round` event from the build session's `verify-before-done`". At PR head 9c4ca3f the only round from the build session is seq 29 (n=1), written by the MCP `report_round` tool, not by the hook: its result names are "pnpm build", "pnpm test", "pnpm test (env -u SDLC_CHANGE -u SDLC_SESSION)", "pnpm lint", "pnpm vitest run packages/hooks/test/hooks.test.ts (...)" (five entries), whereas verify-before-done writes the CLAUDE.md contract names "build", "test", "lint" (packages/hooks/src/verify-before-done.ts:69; compare the hook-written round at seq 19 from the plan session). evals/final-round.json is a copy of that same self-reported round. The hook's actual round (n=2, names build/test/lint, all pass, "553 passed (553)", ts 2026-09-09T18:48:31Z, seq 32) exists only in the worktree's uncommitted sdlc/changes/CHG-0002/log.jsonl (`git status`: " M sdlc/changes/CHG-0002/log.jsonl"); it is not in any commit on the PR branch. Also, the seq-29 "pnpm test" excerpts are not verbatim command output: they begin with the command line ("SDLC_CHANGE=CHG-0001 SDLC_SESSION=sess-launcher pnpm test") and end with an agent-added "launcher exit=0" / "unset exit=0" trailer, and omit the "> vitest run" and "RUN v4.1.11" lines the real output has (compare seq 32). CLAUDE.md: evidence is shown verbatim, never summarised. The code is fine; the committed proof for R6 is not the artefact the spec names. Fix: commit the worktree's ledger line seq 32 (the hook's round) onto the PR branch, or re-run the Stop hook so its round lands in a commit.

data.title: Acceptance line "git diff main --stat lists that file only" is not literally met (three files)
data.detail: plan.md acceptance_line and tasks.yaml target both say "`git diff main --stat` lists that file only". On the PR branch `git diff main...9c4ca3f --stat` lists three files: packages/hooks/test/hooks.test.ts (69 lines), sdlc/changes/CHG-0002/evals/final-round.json (+37), sdlc/changes/CHG-0002/log.jsonl (+5). The two extra files are the system's session bookkeeping (session.started, hook.allowed, round, note, session.stopped) and the done report; no source or other test file strayed, so R7 ("touches packages/hooks/test/hooks.test.ts only") holds in spirit and plan-sync allowed the code commit (seq 28). Reported so the owner reads the acceptance line with that qualifier; a future acceptance line should say "lists that file only outside sdlc/changes/".
